step1_analysis.description: The extracted netlist consists of a chain of four common-source NMOS amplifiers (XM2 -> XM1 -> XM4 -> XM3) sharing a common source node (N7). It likely represents a delay line, a buffer, or the core of a CML (Current Mode Logic) latch used in the phase detector of the CDR circuit. Several dummy or diode-connected transistors (XM5-XM8) are also present, likely for layout matching.

paper_reference.title: A 10-Gb/s CMOS Clock and Data Recovery Circuit With a Half-Rate Binary Phase/Frequency Detector

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the sub-circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 1kΩ pull-up resistors are added to the 5 drain nodes (N0, N1, N3, N6, N11) to make the circuit functional. Average current per branch is ~0.9mA. Total current ~4.5mA. Power = 1.8V * 4.5mA = 8.1mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 91mW reported in the paper is for the entire CDR. This sub-circuit is only a small fraction of the total system.

Voltage Gain.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain from VIN to N3.

sky130_expected.calculation: 4 stages of CS amplifiers. Gain per stage ~ gm * R = 1mS * 1kΩ = 1 V/V. Total gain ~ 1 V/V = 0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen pull-up resistor values and transistor sizing. Since it acts as a digital buffer/delay, high linear gain is not strictly required.

sky130_expected.calculation: RC time constant at each node. R=1kΩ, C~10fF. BW ~ 1 / (2*pi*R*C) ~ 16 GHz. With 4 stages, the overall bandwidth is reduced.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Estimated from parasitic capacitances of W=5u L=0.5u NMOS devices in SKY130.

Propagation Delay.description: Time delay from the input (VIN) to the output (N3).

sky130_expected.calculation: 4 stages, each with ~15ps delay. Total delay ~ 60ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the RC delay of each stage with 1kΩ loads.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient delay of the NMOS chain. Pull-up resistors and a ground connection for the common source node (N7) are added to bias the extracted core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for NMOS Delay Chain
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.2 100MEG 0 0)
VN7 N7 0 0

* Added pull-up resistors to bias the drains
R0 N0 VDD 1k
R1 N1 VDD 1k
R3 N3 VDD 1k
R6 N6 VDD 1k
R11 N11 VDD 1k

* DUT
XM1 N1 N0 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 VIN N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 N6 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 N1 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N7 N7 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N6 N7 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N7 N7 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N11 N7 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

.control
  * DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
  ac dec 20 1MEG 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(N3)
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
  meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  * Transient Analysis for Delay and Swing
  tran 10p 20n
  meas tran delay trig v(VIN) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(N3) val=0.9 rise=2
  meas tran v_max max v(N3)
  meas tran v_min min v(N3)
  let swing = v_max - v_min
  print swing
  
  quit
.endc
.end
